# Borsa Italiana

> Italy's premier stock exchange providing trading platforms, market data, sustainable finance solutions, and financial education for retail and institutional investors.

Borsa Italiana, part of the Euronext group, operates the Milan stock exchange (Palazzo Mezzanotte) and offers comprehensive services including equity trading, derivatives, bonds, ETFs, and ESG-focused investment products. The platform serves as a central hub for capital markets in Italy with educational resources, virtual trading simulators, and professional training through its Academy.

## Trading & Investment Platforms

- [Borsa Virtuale](https://www.borsaitaliana.it/varie/borsa-virtuale/homepage/home.htm): Virtual trading simulator for portfolio creation and investment monitoring
- [Distribuzione Diretta - IPO Service](https://www.borsaitaliana.it/azioni/distribuzione-diretta/home/page.htm): Direct IPO distribution service for retail investors on Borsa Italiana
- [Market Data Services](https://www.borsaitaliana.it/borsaitaliana/information-services/home/market-data.htm): Market data services for banks, investors, media, and data vendors

## Sustainable Finance & ESG

- [Finanza Sostenibile](https://www.borsaitaliana.it/finanza-sostenibile/home-page/home.htm): Sustainable finance hub featuring ESG reporting and sustainable investments
- [Accesso ai Capitali - Sustainable Markets](https://www.borsaitaliana.it/finanza-sostenibile/accesso-ai-capitali/tutti-i-mercati.htm): Capital access and sustainable markets including green bonds and ESG IPOs
- [Sustainable Network & Partnerships](https://www.borsaitaliana.it/finanza-sostenibile/network/partnership.htm): Borsa Italiana Sustainable Network partnerships and ESG finance ecosystem

## Financial Education & Training

- [Academy](https://www.borsaitaliana.it/borsaitaliana/academy/academy/formazione-academy.htm): Professional training and financial education academy for capital markets
- [Formazione Finanziaria - Educational Hub](https://www.borsaitaliana.it/notizie/sotto-la-lente/home/home.htm): Financial education on trading, indices, instruments, and macroeconomics
- [Video Interviste - Expert Interviews](https://www.borsaitaliana.it/notizie/sotto-la-lente/video/interviste.htm): Expert video interviews on derivatives, bonds, ETFs, and equity markets
- [Notizie e Formazione](https://www.borsaitaliana.it/notizie/news/finanza.htm): Financial news updates and educational content on stock market trading

## Market Information & Reference

- [Ultime Notizie - News Archive](https://www.borsaitaliana.it/borsa/notizie/archivi/tutte.html): Stock market news archive with latest financial updates and indices
- [Calendario Borsa - Trading Calendar & Hours](https://www.borsaitaliana.it/borsaitaliana/calendario-e-orari-di-negoziazione/calendario-borsa-orari-di-negoziazione.htm): Trading calendar and hours schedule for Borsa Italiana 2026
- [Eventi e Dividendi - Events & Dividends Calendar](https://www.borsaitaliana.it/borsa/calendario-eventi-dividendi.html): Events calendar and dividend schedule for Euronext Milan markets
- [Glossario Finanziario - Financial Glossary](https://www.borsaitaliana.it/borsa/glossario.html): Financial glossary and terminology reference guide for stock exchange terms
